rod_model_meta.p_r0_after_retract: YAML constant (harness RodSidePlant lock), not tracked

m2_law.rule: moving p_r: lag to p* capped by the valve flow; retract meter-in A_ann |u|, extend meter-out b_T A_h |u| sqrt((p_r - p_T) / dp_c); C_r = A_ann^2 (1/k_r + 1/k_h), B hose not included; M2 reads p_hat = p_r + Delta w, Delta = p_r0 - p_r,rel at the release, w = base release decay (revision 4); extension lock anchor p_r0 = max(min(p_tr, p_ext + max(p_tr - p*, 0)), p_floor), p_tr = moving rod pressure before the lock, p* = extension target; retract lock keeps p_ret (revision 5)

tension_truth.rule: plant p* > p_bB on an unlocked leg with valve > 0, per 1 ms; diagnostic; judged by extend_bound_check

extend_bound_check.rule: ③-on rows (tension_premise.md 5.4, 6.3), plant rod pressure p_tr at every controller read. ext_moving (judged): breach_reads = p_tr > p_hat + delta_m, the sum must be 0; margin_used_reads = p_tr > p_hat is a FLAG. ext_locked: judged by the VB T4h replay (t4h_replay with the ③-on setting, over_0p6kN == 0); here a cross-check FLAG against the monitor's model bound ④ (before the reading bound ⑤): locked_breach_reads = p_tr > ④, locked_breach_over_tol_reads = p_tr > ④ + 0.6 kN / A_ann (the T4h tolerance; > 0 is a FLAG, a VB T4h disagreement is a replay mismatch); locked_vs_extend_bound_reads = p_tr > p_hat + delta_m on locked legs, diagnostic only. 1 Pa rounding allowance; retracting legs apart (premise ④); null record = option off or no rod reading
extend_bound_check.rule_rev5: 436.9 J-P3 (jp3_remedy_spec.md 6.2): reads classified by the estimate the monitor used. jp3a (ext + carry_ext): p_tr > p_hat + delta_m, 1 Pa (judged); jp3b (hold): p_tr > ④ + 0.6 kN / A_ann (judged; 1 Pa strict = FLAG); jp3c (carry_ret): p_tr > max(p_hat + delta_m, retract model), 1 Pa (judged); lock_ext (lock, plant locked after an extension): ④ cross-check FLAG; lock_ret, ret: records
